title: poker: draw action must support SetZone hand
description: transition.py apply_action('draw') only pushes drawn card into player's first per-player zone when it is a StackZone (line 373). Poker hand zones are SetZone. Fix: detect SetZone and call set_add() instead. Test: TestTier2DrawActionGap.test_draw_action_delivers_to_set_zone_hand in tests/test_poker.py should flip from xfail to pass.
